content:
alyssa: Heads up — sec-bot flagged a cert on ded-gw-1 expiring in ~11 days. Can infra confirm rotation plan?
sec-bot: CERT ALERT: ded-gw-1.redwood.internal - SAN: ded-gw-1.redwood.internal - expires 2026-04-04 (11 days) - issuer: Redwood-Prod-CA
samir: On it, checking the rotation pipeline. We have a canary cert staged. Question: is rotation manual for that key or automated via KMS/HSM? @jorge
jorge: I own the KMS key `projects/redwood/keys/prod-transit`. Rotation is manual today (ops runbook). I can grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to `infra-rotation` group for automation, but want EngSec to sign off first.
alyssa: Quick logs check — do we currently ship client CNs or cert details to Datadog? We need to avoid exposing internal hostnames in logs during rotation. Example from syslog: ```Apr  -  syslog ded-gw-1 tls: peer=client-cn=svc-ordering-prod, serial=0A:1B:...```
maria: We redact serial numbers but not CNs today. That's an oversight. I can add a log-filter that drops `peer=client-cn` before shipping. Will open a PR against `logging/pipeline` now.
samir: For TLS policy: edge LB still accepts TLS1.2 for legacy clients (strong ciphers only), but internal service-to-service is TLS1.3-only. Is that still correct? @alyssa
alyssa: Correct. Add a note to runbook: `ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;` and edge ciphers must be AEAD-only. Internal routes are TLSv1.3-only.
jorge: I'll update the rotation runbook with step-by-step and timeline. Plan: 1) deploy canary cert to ded-gw-canary, 2) monitor 2h, 3) roll to remaining gateways over 3-hour window. Also requesting EngSec approval to grant `infra-rotation` group key rotation rights so the job can be automated. @maria can you review scope?
maria: Quick review: scope looks fine but require enforcing MFA and that every rotation action is logged to audit.log. Also restrict the role to `infra-rotation@redwood.com` rather than broad infra group. If those two items are in place, I can approve.
samir: One more: can we enable mTLS for admin endpoints behind the VPC (admin.redwood.internal)? Low risk, but want a +1/-1.
alyssa: +1 for admin endpoints inside VPC only. Prefer canary first (enable on staging-admin), then prod. Add to runbook.
sec-bot: ROTATION JOB: manual rotation scheduled by jorge for 1876600000 (ETA 2026-04-10 02:13:20 UTC).
alyssa: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Maria, ping me when the logging PR is open and I'll sign off on the infra role change once EngSec confirms audit config.
maria: Will do — opening PR and tagging EngSec leads now.
